info.title: Rumi App API
info.description: Use the existing Rumi backend from a lightweight app. Send x-rumi-app-id on API requests and a user Bearer token after login. The app ID identifies an integration; it does not grant access to anyone’s memory. Login through Rumi iMessage, or exchange an already verified identity from your trusted app server. No new Supabase, Photon or ElevenLabs project is required.

post.summary: Exchange your app server’s verified user identity for a Rumi session
post.description: Server-to-server only. The integrating server must authenticate its own user and verify their phone first. Never ship x-rumi-server-key in a mobile or browser build. The phone links to the existing Rumi user used by messaging and calls.
